# Persistence upgrade fixture (baseline `55c4127`)

Real persisted shapes from main at `55c4127` ("exact-head-review-log-408.md を作成"), the
last commit on main before PR #408 (`12b55eb`, "PR3: Batch stability, completion convergence,
and startup recovery") added `jobs.completion_state`, `jobs.completion_error`, and the
`idx_jobs_completion_retry` index. Used only by `tests/test_persistence_upgrade.py`.

- `jobs.sql` — `iterdump()` of a `jobs.db` written by the baseline `JobRepository`:
  10-column `jobs` table, no completion columns, no index. Three rows: `queued`, `running`,
  `succeeded` (with result).
- `assets/` — the Asset record the baseline `AssetRepository.sync_jobs()` wrote for the
  succeeded job.
- `stories/` — a Story written by the baseline `StoryRepository`, where the baseline
  `SceneBinder.bind_job()` bound the succeeded job's asset to `scene_1`
  (`asset_ids.visual`, `job_ids`); `scene_2` / `scene_3` are unbound.

Generated by running those baseline classes from a checkout of `55c4127` (fixed timestamps),
not hand-written. Do not regenerate from current main: the point is that these bytes predate
the completion columns.
